instruction: Please implement a WeChat mini-program for managing orders and a promotion center for accompanying medical services. Users can add orders, view submitted orders, perform refund, cancellation, viewing, and payment operations. At the same time, users can enter the promotion center to view the promotion platform's commission benefits. The WeChat login function allows users to log in with their WeChat account. Users can browse the information of accompanying medical services, select service items, fill in relevant information, submit orders, and make payments. Set the background color to antique white and the component color to sienna.

Please implement an online store system for selling various products. The system should have functionalities for browsing products, adding to cart, placing orders, making payments, and managing orders. Users should be able to log in, browse different categories of products, add selected products to the cart, place orders for selected products, and make payments. The system should also have a user center for managing personal information, browsing consumption records, and checking order status. Apply bisque as the background; style all components with dark salmon.

Please create an affiliate account for promoting products. The account should be able to manage product information, including product name, description, price, etc. Users should be able to log in to the account, browse promoted products, obtain promotion links, and track promotion records. The account should also have the function of managing promotion commissions, including commission calculation and settlement. Assign lavender blush to the background and pale violet red to the UI elements.

Please implement a moving service mini-program for users to place orders online. Users can select the starting and ending points, input moving item information, and the system will automatically calculate the freight. Users can view order status, drivers can accept orders and update order status. The management end can manage user, driver, and order information. Implement powder blue for the page background and royal blue for the elements.

Please implement an online payment gateway integration into an e-commerce website, allowing users to choose a payment method during checkout. The website should have functionalities for adding products to a cart, viewing the cart, checking out, entering payment information, and completing payment. Users should be able to select different payment methods, enter payment information, and complete payment. The website should also display payment status and order information. Style the layout with thistle in the background and medium purple for the interface.

Please implement a campus errand running mini-program to provide errand services. The mini-program should have functionalities for placing orders, order management, and payment. Users should be able to log in, browse available errand services, place orders for selected services, manage their own orders, and make payments. The management end should have functionalities for managing orders, managing users, and managing services. Use pale turquoise as the default background and dark cyan for component styling.

Please implement an online banking system for personal and corporate users to manage accounts and conduct transactions. The system should have functionalities such as user center, account inquiry, transfer, payment, account settings, and more. Users should be able to log in, query account information, conduct transfers and payments, and set account information. The system should also have an institutional management end for managing user registration, UKEY management, system management, and more. Design the site using moccasin as the background and sandy brown for content blocks.

Please implement a payment management system for managing and processing various payment methods. The system should have the ability to add, delete, and modify payment methods, record and statistically analyze payment transaction information, and interface with different financial institutions' payment interfaces. Users should be able to log in, view payment records, manage payment methods, and perform payment operations. Choose wheat for the background; set all component colors to goldenrod.

Please implement an elegant NFT platform for showcasing and trading NFT products. The platform should have functionalities for user registration, login, browsing NFT products, buying and selling NFT products. Users should be able to create their own digital collections and display them on the platform. The platform should have search, filter, and sort functions to enable users to quickly find NFT products of interest. Set light coral as the body background and use brown for the UI.

Please implement a website for unmanned supermarket/warehouse management to provide a convenient shopping experience. The website should have functionalities for shopping, checkout, inventory management, and more. Users should be able to browse products, add to cart, proceed to checkout, and view shopping history. Additionally, the website should have features such as automatic epidemic prevention and disinfection, SKU price management, and more. Administrators should be able to manage product inventory, view sales records, and perform data analysis. Use light sky blue in the background layer and dodger blue for the component layer.

Please modify the product slider on mobile devices so that users can easily browse and select products on their mobile devices. The product slider should be able to automatically adapt to different screen sizes and device types, ensuring a consistent user experience. Additionally, the slider should have clear navigation and interactive elements, such as left and right arrows, pagination dots, etc., to help users quickly find the products they need. Establish pale goldenrod as the main background and dark olive green for the controls.

Please implement a postal points mall website for exchanging goods and managing points. The website should have functionalities for browsing products, exchanging points, proxy redemption, logging in, and registering. Users should be able to log in, browse products, use points to exchange products, perform proxy redemption, and view their point balance and exchange records. Set the background to light sea green, and apply dark slate gray to components.

Please implement a payment aggregation website that supports multiple payment methods. The website should have functionalities for order management, transaction management, system management, merchant management, and service provider management. Users should be able to log in, create orders, select a payment method (such as WeChat, Alipay, Cloud Flash Pay, or bank app scan code payment), make payments, and view order status and transaction records. Merchants should be able to manage their own orders and transaction information, and service providers should be able to manage their own service information. Configure all backgrounds with light slate gray and all components with navy.

Please implement a Magic Dome game platform where users can play games by scanning and paying. The platform should have functionalities for game display, payment, and game launch. Users should be able to browse the game list, select a game, scan and pay, launch the game, and view game progress. The platform should also have user management, order management, and game management functions. Use pale green for container backgrounds and sea green for component visuals.

Please implement a self-driving tour website that provides self-driving tour products and services. The website should have functionalities for browsing self-driving tour routes, booking self-driving tour hotels, and self-help self-driving tour packages. Users should be able to log in, browse different types of self-driving tour routes, book hotels and packages, and query self-driving club information. The website should also provide search and filtering functions to help users quickly find the self-driving tour products they need. Define background as cream; define components with dark teal.

Please implement a payment rebate mini-program that allows users to receive rebates after making payments. The mini-program should have functionalities for logging in, making payments, displaying maps, and showing lists. Users should be able to log in to the mini-program, make payments, view merchant information on the map, browse product lists, and receive rebates after making payments. Apply theme using eggshell as background and dark moss green for elements.

Please implement a Wisdom Life Network platform to connect merchants and riders. The platform should have merchant and rider functionalities, where merchants can manage their stores and orders, and riders can receive and manage their delivery tasks. Users can browse merchant information, place orders, make payments, and evaluate merchants. Riders can view order information, accept orders, and update order status. Use baby blue for the outer layout and navy for UI blocks.

Please implement a bitcoin transaction website for users to conduct bitcoin transactions. The website should have functionalities for registration, login, deposit, withdrawal, and trading. Users should be able to register an account, log in to the website, browse bitcoin prices, perform deposit and withdrawal operations, and conduct buy and sell bitcoin transactions. Set primary background to pearl and elements to charcoal.

Please implement a homestay booking website for customers to search and book homestays. The website should have functionalities for searching homestays, paying booking fees, checking in, paying deposits, applying for cleaning, and extending stays. Users should be able to log in, search and browse homestay listings, book selected listings, pay fees, view smart lock digital passwords, obtain Bluetooth unlocking permissions, and use ID card unlocking. Use a vanilla background and apply dark goldenrod to the UI components.

Please implement a website for Aerospace Optimal Living that provides services such as staff dining, commercial consumption, online shopping, welfare distribution, travel, research and education tourism, team building, and leisure and vacation. The website should have functionalities for user login, registration, personal information management, service booking, order management, and consumption record inquiry. Users should be able to browse and book different types of services, view service details, manage their orders and consumption records. Set overall background to almond, then style components with sienna.

Please implement an unmanned chess and card room ordering mini-program for online self-service ordering and room opening. The mini-program should have functionalities for placing orders, opening rooms, order management, and WeChat payment. Users should be able to log in, browse chess and card room information, place orders for selected rooms, make WeChat payments, and view order status. Staff can manage rooms through the background management system, view order information, and use charts to display the chess and card room's order business data. Apply alice blue to the canvas background and cornflower blue to all visible components.

Please implement a unified code payment platform to provide a convenient and secure payment experience. The platform should have features such as unified aggregated payment QR code, multi-platform payment support, security, and rich payment management functions. Users can complete payments by scanning a single QR code, supporting multiple payment methods such as WeChat and Alipay. The platform should also provide order management, refund management, and other functions to facilitate payment management for merchants. Declare seashell as the global background color and indian red for all UI pieces.

Please implement a blind box lottery mini-program for users to participate in lotteries and purchase products. The mini-program should have functionalities for lottery participation, product purchase, and viewing winning records. Users should be able to directly participate in lotteries or obtain lottery chances by purchasing products. The backend should be able to control lottery settings, including prize settings and lottery probability. Use floral white as the screen background and dark red for component highlights.

Please implement a Taobao affiliate waterfall website for displaying and guiding Taobao products. The website should have functionalities for displaying products in a waterfall layout, filtering products, and viewing product details. Users should be able to browse products, filter products of interest, view product details, and make purchases. Set the background color to lemon chiffon and the component color to olive.

Please implement a home decoration and building materials mini-program mall to display and sell home decoration and building materials products. The mall should have functions such as product display, product details, user registration and login, shopping cart management, shipping address management, and order management. Users should be able to browse and filter products, view product details, register and log in to their accounts, manage their shopping carts, manage shipping addresses, and view their order history. Use lavender for the background and blue violet for components.

Please implement a mobile data service application to provide mobile data services to global users. The application should have functionalities for managing data usage, transaction payments, and account balance inquiries. Users should be able to log in, browse their data usage, make transactions, and view their account balance. The application should also have problem diagnosis and troubleshooting functions to help users resolve issues during use. Define the background as ghost white and components as cadet blue.

Please implement an online payment gateway integration system for handling online store payments. The system should have functionalities for payment processing, order management, and refunds. Users should be able to select products in the online store, submit orders, and make payments through the payment gateway. The system should be able to handle different types of payment methods and provide order status and payment records. Assign beige to the background and brown to the UI elements.

Please implement a web-based Shenzhen intercity payment system for bank payments and financial settlements. The system should have functionalities for user login, payment, transaction inquiry, and account management. Users can log in to the system, perform payment operations, query transaction records, and manage their account information. The system should also have administrator functions, where administrators can manage user information, view transaction records, and configure system parameters. Implement cornsilk for the page background and rosy brown for the elements.

Please implement a same-city delivery website for seasonal fresh products to sell fresh items. The website should have functionalities for browsing products, placing orders, making payments, and managing orders. Users should be able to log in, browse different types of fresh products, place orders for selected products, pay for orders, and check order status. Specify papaya whip as the base color and peru for all components.

Please implement an e-commerce ERP system for managing products, orders, inventory, and more. The system should have functionalities for product management, distribution management, order management, inventory management, account management, statistical analysis, and archiving. Users should be able to log in, browse and manage product, order, and inventory information, perform statistical analysis, and manage archives. Style the layout with pale goldenrod in the background and dark khaki for the interface.

Please implement a form information collection mini-program to collect user information. The mini-program should have functionalities for filling out forms, submitting forms, and viewing submission records. Users should be able to log in to the mini-program, fill out forms, submit forms, and view their own submission records. The mini-program should also have an electronic signature function, allowing users to sign electronic contracts or agreements. Design the site using navajo white as the background and sienna for content blocks.

Please implement a database initialization tool to assist with unit testing. The tool should be able to initialize the database before testing, support various database operations, and integrate with existing unit testing frameworks. Users should be able to easily prepare test data, run tests, and verify test results using this tool. Apply wheat for the layout background and chocolate for interactive elements.

Please implement a bank smart cabinet website for managing and storing important vouchers and certificates. The website should have functionalities for identity authentication, item tracking, monitoring, data entry, inquiry, storage, inventory, and statistical analysis. Users should be able to log in, browse stored vouchers and certificates, query item information, perform storage and retrieval operations, and view statistical analysis reports. Choose peach puff for the background; set all component colors to firebrick.

Please implement a database unit testing tool website for executing JDBC queries and retrieving values. The website should have functionalities for executing SQL queries, creating datasets, and retrieving query results. Users should be able to log in, input SQL query statements, execute queries, view query results, and create and manage datasets. Use light steel blue in the background layer and royal blue for the component layer.

Please implement a driver-side website for automatic loading, used for drivers to receive orders and manage loading. The website should have three parts: homepage, order management, and personal center. Drivers can log in to the website, browse and receive user-published demands, manage their own orders, including loading and delivery status, and view personal information and historical records. Configure all backgrounds with powder blue and all components with medium blue.

Please implement a website maintenance management system for maintaining and managing company websites. The system should have functionalities for server monitoring, website repair, Trojan horse detection, and website design. Users should be able to log in, monitor server status, repair server failures, detect and remove Trojan horses, and design and update website content. Assign sky blue to body backgrounds and navy to main components.

Please implement a distributed database management platform for managing and maintaining distributed databases. The platform should have functionalities for data storage, data query, data backup, and data recovery. Users should be able to log in, create and manage distributed databases, execute data operations, monitor database performance, and perform fault diagnosis and maintenance. Set page background to salmon; color all components with crimson.

Please implement a web optimization tool to merge and compress CSS and JS files. The tool should have functionalities for merging, compressing, and caching. Users should be able to upload CSS and JS files, and the tool will automatically merge and compress the files, providing caching functionality to improve webpage loading speed. Define background as light coral; define components with indian red.

Please implement a MySQL database management website for easy database management. The website should have functionalities for displaying, adding, modifying, and deleting data, restricting input in certain areas, setting filters, and supporting sorting in ascending or descending order. Users should be able to log in, browse database tables, add new data, modify existing data, delete unnecessary data, and filter data based on conditions. Implement styling with misty rose for the background and medium violet red for components.

Please implement a webpage to scrape text data from a specific website and upload it to Google Sheets. The webpage should have the functionality to scrape specific text data (such as names, addresses, product descriptions, etc.) and check the data against certain criteria before uploading it to Google Sheets. Users should be able to set keywords, and the webpage will automatically scrape data containing these keywords and upload it to Google Sheets. Apply theme using rosy brown as background and brown for elements.

Please implement a file transfer tool website for quick file transmission. The website should have functionalities for file uploading, downloading, and sharing. Users should be able to log in, upload files, generate shareable links, set file expiration dates, download files, and view transmission records. The website should also have nearby transfer and AI capabilities, such as intelligent recommendations for related files and optimized transmission speeds. Color the background using thistle and set component styles to rebecca purple.

Please implement a website that converts SMS to XMPP messages. The website should have functionalities for receiving SMS, converting them to XMPP messages, and sending them to target users. Users should be able to configure SMS reception settings, manage conversion rules, and view sending records. Use plum for the outer layout and dark magenta for UI blocks.

Please implement a function to add a custom domain, where users can add and manage their own subdomains on the website. The website should have functionalities for adding, deleting, and editing custom domains. Users should be able to input their own subdomain and bind it to their own server. The system should be able to verify domain ownership and automatically configure domain name resolution. Choose violet for global background and indigo for all components.

Please implement a logistics management website for managing cargo sources, scheduling, vehicle services, and more. The website should have cargo source management functions, including cargo entry, tracking queries, and status operations. Scheduling management functions, including scheduling vehicles, drivers, and time for unsent cargo, generating transportation tracks, and operation records. Vehicle service functions, including managing drivers, vehicle maintenance, and vehicle insurance. Quotation management functions, including maintaining freight and insurance prices for cargo. Supplier management functions, including providing supplier accounting and settlement. User organization functions, including department management, employee management, and permission management. Apply magenta for layout; use dark violet for buttons and cards.

Please implement a monitoring website for server and network status. The website should have functionalities for monitoring CPU, disk, load, services, as well as database, web server, and network connection status. Users should be able to log in, browse monitoring data, set custom monitoring items, and receive email, DingTalk, and QQ alert notifications. Configure your theme with pink as background and deeppink as component color.

Please implement a web application to provide HTTP server functionality. The application should have the ability to handle HTTP requests and responses, including routing, request parameter parsing, and response content generation. Users can access the application through a browser or other HTTP client, send requests, and receive responses. Use a light pink background and apply hotpink to the UI components.

Please create a website to fix the issue of Google Campaign not being eligible due to a compromised site. The website should have the functionality to detect and fix website security vulnerabilities, ensuring the website meets Google Campaign requirements. Users should be able to input their website URL, detect if the website has security issues, and receive repair suggestions. Set overall background to pale turquoise, then style components with medium turquoise.

Please implement a cold chain warehouse management mini-program for quick in and out of warehouse operations. The mini-program should have functionalities for out-of-warehouse, into-warehouse, and inventory query. Users should be able to log in, browse inventory information, perform out-of-warehouse and into-warehouse operations, and query inventory records. Assign aquamarine as the background color and apply dark turquoise to all elements.

Please implement a remote procedure call website that provides remote services. The website should have functionalities for remote calls, data transmission, and error handling. Users should be able to send remote call requests through the website, receive data, and handle error messages. Initialize the background color with medium aquamarine and component color with sea green.

Please implement a high-performance key-value database website for storing and managing data. The website should have multiple data structures such as set, string, hash, sorted set, and list, and support key expiration time setting. Users should be able to log in, create and manage different data structures, set key-value pairs, query and update data, and support automatic garbage collection functionality. Apply turquoise to the canvas background and cadet blue to all visible components.

Please implement a key-value database website based on a log replay mechanism for caching data. The website should have functionalities for storing, retrieving, and deleting data. Users should be able to operate data using specific commands (such as get, set, and delete), and the website should be compatible with existing memcached clients. Users should be able to input a key to retrieve the corresponding value, set new key-value pairs, and delete existing key-value pairs. Declare medium turquoise as the global background color and dark slate gray for all UI pieces.

Please implement a web query proxy website for HTSQL database for querying the database. The website should have functionalities for inputting query statements, executing queries, and displaying query results. Users should be able to input HTSQL query statements, execute queries, and view query results, which can be displayed in HTML or JSON format. Set all pages to have a mint cream background and dark green components.

Please implement a software system that provides API integration and system optimization functions. The system should have functionalities for API interface calls, data processing, and system performance optimization. Users should be able to configure API interfaces through the interface, monitor system performance, and optimize system settings to improve efficiency. Set the background color to spring green and the component color to lime green.

Please implement a website for intelligent operation and management of scrapped car recycling and dismantling. The website should have functionalities for user management, permission management, enterprise distinction, process configuration distinction, image processing, video upload processing, and more. Users should be able to log in, browse scrapped car information, configure enterprise processes, upload images and videos, and manage user permissions. The website should also have functions for new enterprise configuration and regular demand development. Use pale green for the background and forest green for components.

Please implement a Wisdom Veteran mini-program to provide convenient services. The mini-program should have a single sign-on function, an optimized user interface, pages developed according to the owner's needs, and an optimized user experience. Users can log in to the mini-program, browse related services, use the single sign-on function, and enjoy an optimized user experience. Apply light green as the background; style all components with dark olive green.

Please implement a shared operation mini-program for managing and controlling vehicles. The mini-program should have functionalities for vehicle control, low-power vehicle replacement, service area management, electronic fence management, IoT control, and Bluetooth control. Users should be able to log in to the mini-program, view detailed real-time vehicle information, control vehicle status, manage service areas and electronic fences, and perform IoT control and Bluetooth control. Define the background as khaki and components as dark khaki.

Please implement a freight management mini-program for signing and receiving, and scanning and printing. The mini-program should have a signing and receiving function, allowing users to scan cargo information and automatically return the signing status. At the same time, the mini-program should also have a scanning and printing function, allowing users to scan cargo information and print related documents. Users can log in to the mini-program, browse cargo information, sign for cargo, scan and print documents, and view signing records. Assign light goldenrod yellow to the background and olive drab to the UI elements.

Please implement a secure Smm panel website to protect user data and prevent unauthorized access. The website should have functionalities to prevent unauthorized access, protect against malware and viruses, and ensure secure data transmission. Users should be able to log in securely and browse and manage their data, and the website should prevent unauthorized access and data breaches. Configure the background color to gold, with components using dark goldenrod.

Please implement a new energy charging pile management system for managing charging piles and user charging behavior. The system should have user, management, and maintenance ends. The user end should allow users to find nearby charging stations, view charging pile usage, navigate to charging stations, start and stop charging, view orders and account information, etc. The management end should allow administrators to manage portal websites, public accounts, forums, messages, etc., manage orders, warranties, charging cards, and other information, support corporate accounts, and interface with parking lots, etc. Implement light goldenrod for the page background and goldenrod for the elements.

Please implement a database management tool website for managing SQL database content. The website should have functionalities for real-time data updates, data queries, and data editing. Users should be able to log in, browse database content, query data, edit data, and update data in real-time. The website should also have an API interface, allowing users to access and manipulate data through REST and GraphQL. Specify light beige as the base color and sienna for all components.

Please implement a waste management website for cities to manage the transportation and inventory of industrial waste. The website should have functionalities for enterprise information maintenance, waybill management, plan filing, and cross-provincial business application. Users should be able to log in, maintain their own enterprise information, manage waybills, submit plan filings, and apply for cross-provincial business. The regulatory end should have functions such as county and district account statistics and plan review. Style the layout with cream in the background and dark orange for the interface.

Please implement a lightweight database operation interface that supports concurrent operations. The interface should have functionalities for querying, adding records, modifying records, and more, and should support multiple operations happening simultaneously, ensuring that background operations do not block the main thread and that data changes are updated in real-time. Users should be able to easily manage the database through the interface, including browsing data, adding new data, modifying existing data, and more. Use peach as the default background and orangered for component styling.

Please implement a database operation website for executing database queries. The website should have functionalities for querying, adding, deleting, and modifying data. Users should be able to log in, execute complex database queries, view query results, and perform CRUD operations on data. Design the site using melon as the background and tomato for content blocks.

Please implement an instant messaging website for sending messages and team collaboration. The website should have functionalities for single chat, group chat, contact list, and application management. Users should be able to log in and send various types of messages, including text, images, and videos, and engage in multi-person group collaboration and message management to improve work efficiency and promote team cooperation. Apply buttermilk for the layout background and peru for interactive elements.

Please implement a database security management website for managing and protecting databases. The website should have functionalities for database backup, encryption, migration, and compatibility verification. Users should be able to log in and perform database backup, encryption, migration, and compatibility verification operations. The website should also have data integrity and consistency comparison functionality to ensure data accuracy and reliability. Choose apricot for the background; set all component colors to chocolate.

Please implement a combined backend service website for handling large and small package loading and unloading processes for SF Express. The website should have functionalities for managing loading and unloading processes, tracking order status, and querying historical records. Users should be able to log in, browse information on large and small package loading and unloading, manage the loading and unloading process, track order status, and query historical records. Style all pages with a frost white background and charcoal components.

Please implement a web application for a configuration-based PHP framework, which should have modular, extensible, and easy-to-maintain features. Users should be able to configure framework parameters, manage modules, and view logs through the web interface. The web application should have basic functions such as user login, registration, and password recovery, and should be able to display framework version information, documentation, and more. Use lavender blush in the background layer and deep pink for the component layer.

Please implement a website that uses Redis for data storage. The website should have functionalities for storing data, reading data, updating data, and deleting data. Users should be able to store and manage data through the website, including setting key-value pairs, getting values, updating values, and deleting key-value pairs. Establish eggshell as the main background and dark slate gray for the controls.

Please implement a city management mini-program that provides convenient city services. The mini-program should have functionalities for reporting, inquiring, and handling affairs. Users should be able to log in, submit reports, check the progress of their applications, view handling guides, and make online payments. Set the background to pale rose, and apply maroon to components.

Please implement a database smart proxy service website for managing database requests. The website should have functionalities for setting routing rules, managing servers, monitoring requests, and viewing request logs. Users should be able to log in, set routing rules, manage servers, monitor requests, and view request logs. Configure all backgrounds with pale lilac and all components with dark orchid.

Please implement a web application firewall to filter out malicious traffic and crawler collection. The firewall should have a flexible rule configuration function to distinguish between real traffic and collection garbage traffic. Users should be able to configure rules to filter specific IP addresses, user agents, request methods, and more. The firewall should also be able to record and analyze traffic logs, providing real-time traffic monitoring and alerting functions. Assign mint frost to body backgrounds and seagreen to main components.

Please implement a home committee circle sharing mini-program for communication and sharing between parents and teachers. Users can create schools and home committees, apply to join them, and post various types of posts. Posts can be set to be visible only to the class or to all users, and can also be assigned to a specific topic. Posts within the class need to be reviewed by administrators before being published to the school. Administrators are divided into school administrators and class administrators, with different permissions, including posting announcements, pinning posts, and approving class membership applications. Set page background to faint gray; color all components with slate gray.

Please implement a brain electrical activity exchange mini-program for doctors to share brain electrical images and case information. The mini-program should have functionalities for publishing cases, browsing others' published cases, uploading images and videos, and displaying user comments. Doctors should be able to log in, publish their own typical or difficult cases, browse and learn from other doctors' published cases, and view user comments and a leaderboard. Apply theme using silver as background and dark slate blue for elements.

Please implement a web application based on Spark-java that has user registration, login, browsing, and search functions. Users should be able to register an account, log in to the system, browse different types of content, and search for information of interest. The system should have basic user management functions, including user information modification and password reset. Configure your theme with moonstone as background and steel blue as component color.

Please implement a mobile guestbook website for users to leave and view messages. The website should have functionalities for leaving messages, viewing messages, and deleting messages. Users should be able to log in, input message content, submit messages, view all messages, delete their own messages, and reply to messages. Assign ice blue as the background color and apply teal to all elements.

Please implement a web application using AJAX technology, with features such as a message board, login, and data grabbing. Users should be able to interact with the server through the web page, sending and receiving data without needing to refresh the entire page. The web page should have real-time update functionality, displaying the latest data in a timely manner. Initialize the background color with cool gray and component color with charcoal.

Please implement a government affairs app that provides information and services related to government affairs. The app should have functionalities for viewing representative information, submitting suggestions, querying government affairs news, and participating in discussions. Users should be able to log in, browse representative information, submit suggestions, query government affairs news, and participate in discussions. Use desert sand as the screen background and sienna for component highlights.

Please implement a public number website for the car repair tribe, used for data query and problem assistance. The website should have two core functional modules: data query and problem assistance. Users can use the data query module to quickly retrieve the information they need, and use the problem assistance module to post help requests and forward them to friends or professionals for help. Users can also browse and search the database, view the history of help requests, and comment and reply to help information. Set the background color to linen white and the component color to burlywood.

Please implement a smart community management platform for community information management and services. The platform should have functionalities such as a homepage carousel, community map, information announcements, questionnaire surveys, cultural activities, resident discussions, and garbage classification queries. Users should be able to browse community information, participate in questionnaire surveys, view cultural activities, propose resident discussions, and query garbage classification information. Users should also be able to view their own activity and survey records and switch between communities. Define the background as feather white and components as dark green.

Please implement an interactive cartoon database website for cartoon enthusiasts to discover, rate, review, and share their favorite cartoons. The website should have a database feature that allows users to add both animated and comic cartoons, and a queue system for moderators to review and approve user-submitted entries. Users should be able to discover new cartoons, rate and review existing ones, and create and share personal watchlists. The website should also have a rating and review system that allows users to rate cartoons based on a star-rating system and provide written reviews. Choose gainsboro for the background; set all component colors to dark slate blue.
